'''Sub-Prefect''' was a position within the hierarchy of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that was subservient to the position of [[Imperial Prefect]]. The individuals [[Matagorn]] and [[Helkson Vall]] both held the position of Sub-Prefect.
